experiment_1_ax_dynamic_orchestration.orchestration_layer_verdict: AX is an Infrastructure/CRD Orchestrator. Agent Lab Control Plane is REQUIRED above AX.

experiment_2_workload_identity.rationale: Directly carries task_id, workspace_id, role, and tenant claims required for dynamic evaluation without external SPIRE server overhead while remaining compatible with k8s Projected SA tokens.

experiment_3_identity_persistence.conclusion: Logical workload identity is bound to the durable session/task and completely decoupled from ephemeral physical worker pods.

experiment_4_dynamic_authorization.conclusion: Dynamic authorization computes effective scope dynamically from the intersection of context and constraints without static agent permissions.

experiment_5_dynamic_discovery.conclusion: Agents dynamically discover eligible peers by capability and policy filter rather than static hardcoded target IDs.

experiment_6_delegation_and_gateway_enfo.security_boundary: Agent Gateway intercepting all inter-agent traffic
